y-m-36-02.title: Kuziva root imwe chete kunotara ma coefficients here?
y-m-36-02.topic: Root imwe ye quadratic equation neruzivo runodiwa kuti ma coefficients atarwe
y-m-36-02.goal: Verenga kuti ruzivo rwekuti "root imwe yapiwa" runotara ma coefficients mangani, sarudza ruzivo rwekuwedzera runokwana kutara ma coefficients kumhinduro imwe, uye ugadzire iwe pachako muenzaniso unogutsa mamiriro.
y-m-36-02.material: Kune quadratic equation x² + ax + b = 0 (a ne b ndema real numbers), chaunoziva ndechekuti x = 2 ndi root. Soyeong akati, "Kana ukaisa x = 2, unogona kuwana a ne b," uye Daon akati, "Izvozvo oga hazvina ruzivo rwakakwana." (Verenga se: x squared plus a x plus b equals 0)
y-m-36-02.thinking.0: Kuenzanisa huwandu hweruzivo (huwandu hwema equations) nehwe unknowns kuti utsvage
y-m-36-02.thinking.1: Kuedza ruzivo rwekuwedzera rumwe nerumwe kuti rwakakwana here
y-m-36-02.prereq.0: Zvinoreva root ye equation (kuisa root kunoita kuti equation ive yechokwadi)
y-m-36-02.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pe roots mbiri dze quadratic equation ne ma coefficients ayo (nhanho ye equations unit ye Grade 10) — H2 yebasa iri inongova nhanho yekuoma neyerubatsiro mukugoverwa kwekugadzira uku; haireve kuti curriculum inopa chidzidzo ichi kugiredhi iyoyo. Fungidzira kuti ruzivo rwekutanga runotevera rwatodzidzwa.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.prompt: Enzanisa zvakataurwa naSoyeong naDaon, uye usarudze kutonga kunokodzera zvakanyanya nezve ruzivo runozikanwa zvino.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.hint.0: Isa a = 0, 1, −1 imwe imwe, uye gadzirisa b kuti x = 2 ive root.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana mapeya ose awakagadzira anogutsa mamiriro. Kana zvakadaro, pane mhinduro dzakawanda sei?
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.a: Equation imwe yaunowana nekuisa x = 2 inokuita kuwana a ne b zvose.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvinotora equation imwe sekugona kutara ma unknowns maviri. Edza kutsvaga kuti b inova chii kana a iri 0, 1, ne −1.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.b: Kana x = 2 ndi root, saka b inofanira kuva 0.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.b: Hauna kutarisa kana pane chikonzero chekuti b ive 0 kana root isiri 0. Tsvaga b kana a = 0.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.c: Sezvo root imwe chete yakapiwa, equation iyi inofanira kuva ne double root.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunotora "root imwe inozikanwa" ne "root imwe chete" sezvinhu zvimwe chete. Tsvaga roots dzose kana a = −1.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.o.d: Kuisa kunopa equation imwe chete, saka a ne b hazvigoni kutarwa kumhinduro imwe.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.r.d: Kutonga uku kunoenzanisa huwandu hwe unknowns nehwema equations awanikwa.
y-m-36-02.s.s1.explain: Kuisa x = 2 kunopa equation imwe, 4 + 2a + b = 0. Pane ma unknowns maviri, a ne b, saka mapeya asingaperi anogoneka, senge (a, b) = (0, −4), (−1, −2), (1, −6). Kungopiwa root imwe hakureve kuti imwe root ine kukosha kumwe chete.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.prompt: Fungidzira kuti imwe neimwe yapiwa zvakaparadzana. Sarudza ruzivo rwekuwedzera rwose rwunokwana kutara a ne b kumhinduro imwe.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, nyora ruzivo rutsva seequation uye uigadzirise pamwe chete ne equation yawatove nayo, 4 + 2a + b = 0, wozoverenga mapeya (a, b) mangani anobuda.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kune sarudzo dzisingatari mhinduro, tarisa nekugadzira mapeya maviri akasiyana anogutsa mamiriro.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.a: Wakatarisa kana kuziva roots dzose mbiri kunotara a ne b zvose kuburikidza ne sum ne product.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.b: Kutonga uku kunotarisa kana unogona kuwana b nokubatanidza nechirevo chawatoita, 4 + 2a + b = 0.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.o.c: a ne b zvose inhamba dzizere.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.c: Hauna kuverenga kuti mapeya mangani anosangana na 4 + 2a + b = 0 anosara nemamiriro enhamba dzizere. (0, −4) ne (−2, 0) mapeya enhamba dzizere ose mbiri.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.d: Hauna kuparadzanisa ruzivo runoderedza mhando neruzivo runogadzirisa mhinduro imwe chete. Pane mapeya mazhinji (a, b) anosangana nemamiriro aya zvakare.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.r.e: Kutonga uku kunotarisa kana hukama hwakapiwa nyowani, pamwe chete nechirevo chekutanga, hunoita zvirevo zviviri.
y-m-36-02.s.s2.explain: Kana mumwe mudzi uri −3, saka huwandu −1 = −a nechakawanikwa −6 = b zvinoyagadzirisa. Kana a = −1, wobva wava b = −2. Kana b = a + 2, saka 4 + 2a + a + 2 = 0 inopa a = −2, b = 0. Mamiriro enhamba dzizere ne "nhamba chaiyo dzakasiyana" anoderedza mhando chete, uye mapeya akati wandei anosara.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, gadzira mapeya maviri akasiyana (a, b) apo a ne b dzinhamba dzizere uye midzi miviri ye x² + ax + b = 0 inhamba chaiyo dzakasiyana dziri pamusoro, umwe wazvo uri 2.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga washandisa 4 + 2a + b = 0 kuenzanisa b na a, wobva waratidza nomuna a kuti mumwe mudzi ndeupi.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.hint.1: Yedza kukosha kwakati wandei kwa a kuti mumwe mudzi uve uri pamusoro uye usiri 2.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.fail.c1: Ndapota ita a ne b dzose dzive nhamba dzizere.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.ok.c3: Mumwe mudzi inhamba iri pamusoro isiri 2.
y-m-36-02.s.s3.fail.c3: Mumwe mudzi haupo pamusoro kana wakaenzana ne 2, saka haupi "midzi miviri yakasiyana iri pamusoro."
y-m-36-02.s.s3.explain: Semuenzaniso, (a, b) = (−3, 2) inopa x² − 3x + 2 = (x − 1)(x − 2), ine midzi 1 ne 2, uye (−5, 6) inopa midzi 2 ne 3. (−4, 4) ine mudzi mumwe chete, 2 (mudzi wakapetwa), uye (−1, −2) ine mumwe mudzi −1, saka hapana unosangana nemamiriro. Mapeya mazhinji anosangana nemamiriro ose aya, saka unogona kusimbisazve kuti mamiriro haagadziri mhinduro imwe chete.

y-m-36-09.title: Quadratic equation umo huwandu nemugumisiro zvose zvakanaka
y-m-36-09.topic: Zviratidzo zvemaroots maviri equadratic equation nemamiriro ehuwandu nemugumisiro
y-m-36-09.goal: Wana mamiriro asipo muchirevo "kana huwandu nemugumisiro zvose zvakanaka, maroots ose maviri akanaka" nekugadzira counterexample iwe amene, uye ugadzirise chirevo kuti chive chechokwadi.
y-m-36-09.material: Mina akataura chirevo: "Kune quadratic equation x² − sx + q = 0 (s ne q nhamba chaiyo), kana huwandu s nemugumisiro q wemaroots maviri zvose zvakanaka, saka maroots ose maviri nhamba chaiyo dzakanaka." (Verenga se: x squared minus s x plus q equals 0) Huwandu hwemaroots maviri i s uye mugumisiro i q.
y-m-36-09.thinking.1: Gadzira counterexample inoita mamiriro asi ichiputsa mhedziso
y-m-36-09.thinking.2: Gadzirisa chirevo nekuwedzera mamiriro umo chinoshanda
y-m-36-09.prereq.0: Hukama hunotaura huwandu nemugumisiro wemaroots maviri equadratic equation nemacoefficients ayo
y-m-36-09.prereq.1: Maitiro ekutonga kana maroots equadratic equation ari real kana kwete (ukuru hweyuniti yemaequation egiredhi 10) — H2 yemushando uyu inongova kuoma nechiyero chetsigiro mukugoverwa kwekugadzira uku; haireve kuti curriculum inopa chidzidzo icho kugiredhi iroro. Fungidzira ruzivo rwekutanga rwuri pazasi rwatodzidzwa.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza kutonga kwako kwekutanga nezvechirevo chaMina.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.hint.0: Isa mapeya mashoma enhamba dzakanaka dzakatarwa dza s ne q uye uwane maroots eequation iwe amene.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana pane nyaya umo maroots asiri real, uye ushande kana mhedziso "nhamba chaiyo dzakanaka" ichiri yakarurama ipapo.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.a: Inoshanda chete kana huwandu hwakanaka uye mugumisiro usina.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.a: Wakaverenga kumashure hukama hwekuti kana mugumisiro wakanaka, maroots maviri ane chiratidzo chakafanana.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.b: Pane nyaya umo isingashande. Root imwe inogona kuva isina.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.b: Wakashaya kuti kana mugumisiro wakanaka, maroots maviri chaiwo ane chiratidzo chakafanana. Semuenzaniso, gadzira mapeya mashoma emaroots maviri chaiwo ane huwandu hwakanaka nemugumisiro wakanaka.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.c: Inogara ichishanda. Kana huwandu nemugumisiro zvakanaka, maroots ose maviri akanaka.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.c: Hauna kuedza macounterexamples kuona kana zviratidzo zvehuwandu nemugumisiro zvoga zvichikwana.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.o.d: Inogona kusashanda. Pane nyaya umo maroots asiri real.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.r.d: Wakaongorora kufungidzira kwekuti maroots anofanira kuva real kuti zviratidzo zvehuwandu nemugumisiro zvitiudze zviratidzo zvemaroots.
y-m-36-09.s.s1.explain: Kana mugumisiro wakanaka uye maroots ose maviri ari real, maroots maviri ane chiratidzo chakafanana, uye kana huwandu hwakanaka, ose akanaka. Asi kana maroots asiri real, ndiko kuti, maroots eimaginary, izwi re "chiratidzo" harigoni kushandiswa, uye huwandu nemugumisiro zvinogona kuramba zvakanaka. Semuenzaniso, maroots e x² − 2x + 5 = 0 i1 ± 2i.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapeya maviri akasiyana (s, q) anoputsa chirevo chaMina. Huwandu s nemugumisiro q zvose zvakanaka, asi maroots maviri eequation x² − sx + q = 0 haafanire kuva nhamba chaiyo dzakanaka.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza kukosha kwa s, wobva wawedzera q zvishoma nezvishoma uye utarise kuti maroots eequation anochinja sei.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.hint.1: Kune s yega yega, wana kuti muganhu we q unoparadzanisa maroots chaiwo nemaroots asiri chaiwo uri papi.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.fail.c1: s ne q zvinofanira kuva zvakakura kupfuura 0.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Maroots maviri haasi real, saka chirevo chinoputswa.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Kune (s, q) iyi, maroots maviri ari real. Gadzirisa equation uye uongorore kana maroots ari real.
y-m-36-09.s.s2.explain: Kana (s, q) = (2, 5), maroots i1 ± 2i; kana (1, 1), maroots i(1 ± √3 i)/2; kana (4, 10), maroots i2 ± √6 i. (5, 6) ine maroots chaiwo akanaka 2 ne3, uye (4, 4) ine root imwe chete, 2 (double root), inhamba chaiyo yakanaka, saka hapana inoputsa chirevo. Macounterexamples ndinyaya umo maroots ari imaginary kunyange huwandu nemugumisiro zvakanaka.
y-m-36-09.s.s3.prompt: Mamiriro api aunofanira kuwedzera kuti chirevo chaMina chive chirevo chakarurama? Nyorawo chikonzero, uchitaura counterexample yawakangogadzira.
y-m-36-09.s.s3.hint.0: Kune (s, q) yawakagadzira secounterexample, wana maroots eequation iwe amene uye uongorore kana ari real.
y-m-36-09.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora kuti mamiriro api anogona kusefa counterexample iyoyo achisiya mamiriro ehuwandu nemugumisiro sezvakaita.

y-m-36-08.title: Ndeipi pamhinduro mbiri icharamba ichibatsira?
y-m-36-08.topic: Integer roots dze cubic equation nekuenzanisa nzira dzekugadzirisa
y-m-36-08.goal: Enzanisa nzira mbiri dzekugadzirisa, ongorora mamiriro ayo imwe neimwe inogona kushandiswa, uye ugadzire hurongwa hwekugadzirisa nekugadzira iwe pachako cubic equation ine integer roots.
y-m-36-08.material: Hajun naSeoyun vakagadzirisa cubic equation x³ − 2x² − x + 2 = 0. Hajun: akaita boka rema terms maviri ekutanga nema terms maviri ekupedzisira ndokuashandura kuita x²(x − 2) − (x − 2) = (x − 2)(x² − 1). Seoyun: akaisa x = 1, akasimbisa kuti inopa 0, uye akapatsanura ne x − 1 kuwana (x − 1)(x² − x − 2). Vese vaviri vakawana roots −1, 1, 2. (Verenga se: x cubed minus 2x squared minus x plus 2 equals 0)
y-m-36-08.thinking.1: Tonga kana nzira inogona kuramba ichishandiswa kana mamiriro achichinja
y-m-36-08.prereq.0: Factor theorem ne synthetic division (kupatsanura polynomial ne linear expression)
y-m-36-08.prereq.1: Chokwadi chekuti ma candidates e integer roots e equation ine integer coefficients i ma divisors e constant term (padanho reyuniti ye equations yegiredhi re10) — H2 yebasa iri i danho rekunetsa nerekutsigira chete mukugoverwa uku kwekugadzira; hazvireve kuti curriculum inopa chidzidzo icho kugiredhi iroro. Fungidzira kuti ruzivo rwunodiwa pazasi rwatodzidzwa.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.prompt: Ndeipi tsananguro yakakodzera zvikuru inoenzanisa mhinduro mbiri?
y-m-36-08.s.s1.hint.0: Pamhinduro imwe neimwe yembiri, nyora mutsetse mumwe kuti yakashandisa chimiro chipi chedambudziko (chimiro che expression, constant term).
y-m-36-08.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana mhinduro imwe neimwe yaigona kuramba ichishandiswa kana chimwe chezvimiro zviviri chikanyangarika.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.a: Mhinduro yaHajun chete ndiyo yakarurama. Seoyun akangowana x = 1 se root nenjodzi.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunotora kuwana roots nekuisa sekusingavimbiki.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.b: Mhinduro yaSeoyun chete ndiyo yakarurama. Kuita boka i hunyanzvi hunoshanda padambudziko iri chete.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.b: Wakatarisa range chete apo nzira imwe inoshanda uye wakarasa imwe.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.c: Mhinduro dzose dzakarurama, uye zviratidzo zvakashandiswa nemumwe nemumwe zvakasiyana.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.c: Wakasiyanisa kuti nzira mbiri dzinoshandisa zviratidzo zvakasiyana.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.o.d: Mhinduro dzakafanana, saka hapana chikonzero chekuongorora nzira zvakaparadzana.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.r.d: Hauna kusiyanisa chokwadi chekuti mhinduro dzakafanana nekuti nzira ndeyakajairika zvakadini.
y-m-36-08.s.s1.explain: Hajun akashandisa chimiro umo mutaurire unogona kurongedzwa nekubatanidza mapoka, uye Seoyun akashandisa madivisors echikamu chakagara samakandidate ekuwana root. Zvose zviri kuverenga kwakarurama, uye mamiriro avanoshandisa akasiyana. Dambudziko iri rakaita mamiriro ose maviri, saka dzose dzakashanda.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.prompt: Chinja chikamu chakagara kuti equation ive x³ − 2x² − x + 3 = 0. Chirevo chipi chakarurama nezvemutaurire uyu?
y-m-36-08.s.s2.hint.0: Isa x = 1, −1, 3, −3 uye uverenge kukosha kwemutaurire kune imwe neimwe.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti zviratidzo zvekukosha kwemutaurire zvinosiyana sei pa x = −2 nepa x = −1.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.o.a: Kubatanidza mapoka kwaHajun kunoshanda sezvakaita, uye factoring yapera pakarepo.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.r.a: Hauna kunyora zvechokwadi kana chinhu chakajairika chichisara mushure mekubatanidza mapoka. Ongorora kuti mazwi maviri ekupedzisira i −x + 3.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.o.b: Kuisa ±1, ±3 kunopa kukosha kwose kusiri 0, saka hapana root yeinteger.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.r.b: Wakasiyanisa kuti nzira yekuedza makandidate ose emaintegers inogona kukuudza kusvika kupi.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.o.c: Hapana root yeinteger, saka equation iyi haina mhinduro uye kugadzirisa kwapera.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.r.c: Wakatora "hapana root yeinteger" ne "hapana mhinduro" sezvakafanana. Enzanisa zviratidzo zvekukosha kwemutaurire pa x = −2 nepa x = −1.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.o.d: Kubatanidza mapoka kana kuisa kwose hazvishande, saka equation iyi haigoni kugadziriswa.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.r.d: Kutonga uku kunoti kana nzira dziri mukati memaintegers dzakamira, hapana imwe nzira. Fungidzira kuti unogona kuziva sei kuti real root iripo.
y-m-36-08.s.s2.explain: Kuisa x = 1, −1, 3, −3 kunopa kukosha kwemutaurire 1, 1, 9, −39, hapana iri 0, saka hapana root yeinteger. Asi pa x = −2 i−11 uye pa x = −1 i1, saka pane real root pakati pazvo. Hazvirevi kuti hapana mhinduro; haingowiri paninteger.
y-m-36-08.s.s3.prompt: Panguva ino, kune x³ − 2x² − x + c = 0, gadzira (r, c) kuti integer r ive root. Isa mienzaniso mitatu ine kukosha kwakasiyana kwe c. (r ne c zvose maintegers)
y-m-36-08.s.s3.hint.0: Isa integer kuna r uye ugadzirise equation r³ − 2r² − r + c = 0 kuti uwane c.
y-m-36-08.s.s3.hint.1: Edza r dzakawanda uye urongedze mutebhura kana pane nyaya umo c yakafanana.
y-m-36-08.s.s3.fail.c1: Ndapota ita r ne c maintegers.
y-m-36-08.s.s3.fail.c2: Kana ukaisa r, mutaurire haungaiti 0. Isa r mumutaurire uye ugadzirise c.
y-m-36-08.s.s3.explain: Kana r iri root, saka kubva pa r³ − 2r² − r + c = 0, c yakagadzikwa se c = −r³ + 2r² + r. r = 1, 2, −1 dzose dzinopa c = 2, saka iequation imwe chete, uye r = 0 inopa c = 0, r = 3 inopa c = −6, uye r = −2 inopa c = 14. Mamiriro ekuwana mienzaniso ine c dzakasiyana anokubvisa pakuverenga equation imwe chete neroot yakasiyana.
y-m-36-08.s.s4.prompt: Nyora nokupfupika chirongwa chekugadzirisa cubic equation chaunogona kushandisa chero chikamu chakagara chiri integer ipi. Sanganisa zvauchaita kana kubatanidza mapoka kusingashande uye kana makandidate ose emaintegers akundikana.
y-m-36-08.s.s4.hint.0: Nhamba kuti ndechipi pakubatanidza mapoka, kuisa, nekugovanisa chaunoedza uye nekutevedzana kupi.
y-m-36-08.s.s4.hint.1: Shanda zvaunogona kuziva nezvisingagoni kuzivikanwa kana pasina kukosha kwawakaisa kunopa 0.
y-m-36-08.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Chirongwa changu chakarongedzwa nenzira (1) kuedza makandidate, (2) zvekuita mushure mekuwana root, (3) zvekuita kana izvozvo zvikundikana here?
y-m-36-08.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ndakadzivisa kupedzisa kuti hapana mhinduro nokuti pasina root yeinteger here?

y-m-36-01.title: Kuverenga real roots dze equation ine m mairi
y-m-36-01.topic: Huwandu hwe real roots dze equation ine letter coefficient, nekutarisa zvinofungidzirwa
y-m-36-01.goal: Mumhinduro apo kuverenga kwose kunoratidzika kwakarurama, tsvaga mutsara 'unogona kushandiswa chete pamusoro pekufungidzira kunoti', tsvaga nyaya dzose apo pane real root imwe chete, uye utarise renji nekuisa makosha.
y-m-36-01.material: Jihu akagadzirisa nyaya iri pazasi, inobvunza renji re m apo equation mx² − 4x + 1 = 0 mu x (m ndi real number) ine real roots mbiri dzakasiyana. Nyaya inoti "equation" chete uye haiti "quadratic equation." Real root ndiyo mhinduro iri real number, uye kana roots mbiri dziri kukosha kumwe chete (double root), inoverengwa seiyo real root imwe. (Verenga se: m times x squared minus 4x plus 1 equals 0)
y-m-36-01.thinking.0: Ongorora kuti mutsara mumwe nemumwe wemhinduro wakamira pakufungidzira kupi
y-m-36-01.thinking.1: Tsvaga iwe pachako makosha apo unofanira kuparadzanisa nyaya
y-m-36-01.prereq.0: Nzira yekusarudza huwandu hwe roots dze quadratic equation (nhanho ye equations unit ye Grade 10)
y-m-36-01.prereq.1: Kusiyanisa linear equations ne quadratic equations — H2 yebasa iri inongova nhanho yekuoma neyerubatsiro mukugoverwa kwekugadzira uku; haireve kuti curriculum inopa chidzidzo ichi kugiredhi iyoyo. Fungidzira kuti ruzivo rwekutanga runotevera rwatodzidzwa.
y-m-36-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe mumhinduro yaJihu une dambudziko. Nhamba dzemitsara dzinotanga pamutsara 1.
y-m-36-01.s.s1.hint.0: Isa makosha akati kuti 3, 0, ne −1 se m, nyora equation chaiyo, uye uverenge real roots iwe pachako.
y-m-36-01.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa zvawakaverenga nemhedziso iri mumutsara we4. Kana kukosha kupi nekupi kusingaenderani, tarisa kuti equation inova nechimiro chipi pakukosha ikoko.
y-m-36-01.s.s1.line.0: Kuti ive ne real roots mbiri dzakasiyana, discriminant inofanira kugutsa D > 0.
y-m-36-01.s.s1.explain: Kuverenga kwemitsara 2 ne3 (D = 16 − 4m, m < 4) kwakarurama. Dambudziko riri mumutsara 1. D > 0 ndiyo mamiriro e real roots mbiri chete kana equation iri quadratic, asi munyaya ino, kana m = 0 equation inova linear equation −4x + 1 = 0, ine real root imwe chete, x = 1/4. Saka mhedziso yemutsara we4, m < 4, inosanganisira m = 0 zvisina kururama. Kunyangwe wakasarudza mutsara 1 kana mutsara 4, wakaona danho rimwe chete uchitarisa kubva kunzvimbo dzakasiyana. Kana wakangonetseka nemitsara 3 yekutanga, wakangoongorora kuverenga zvakare, uye chikonzero chikuru chenyaya ino ndechekuti kuverenga kwakarurama.
y-m-36-01.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga makosha maviri akasiyana e m apo equation mx² − 4x + 1 = 0 ine real root imwe chete, uye uaise. (m ndi real number)
y-m-36-01.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza kukosha kwe m, nyora equation, uye tanga watarisa chimiro che expression mu x (degree yaro ndeipi).
y-m-36-01.s.s2.hint.1: Pane zvikonzero zviviri zvakasiyana zvekuva ne real root imwe. Funga danho rawakawana nhanho yapfuura uye nyaya apo roots dzinosangana.
y-m-36-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Ne m iyi, pane real root imwe chete.
y-m-36-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ne m iyi, hapana real root imwe chete. Isa m, nyora equation iwe pachako, uye uverenge roots.
y-m-36-01.s.s2.explain: Kana m = 0, saka −4x + 1 = 0, saka pane x = 1/4 chete, uye kana m = 4, saka 4x² − 4x + 1 = (2x − 1)² = 0, saka x = 1/2 ndiyo root imwe inoverengwa kaviri. Idzi ndidzo nyaya mbiri apo pane real root imwe nezvikonzero zvakasiyana. m = 1 inopa real roots mbiri, uye m = 5 ne m = −3 dzinopa 0 ne2 real roots nenzira yakateedzana.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.prompt: Ndeipi yeidzi i "renji re m apo pane real roots mbiri dzakasiyana" kubva pamhinduro yakagadziriswa? Chero m yaunoisa, unogona kunyora equation iwe pachako uye uverenge roots kuti utarise.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.hint.0: Isa m = −1, 1, 0, 4, 5 imwe imwe uye urange huwandu hwe real roots mutafura.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.hint.1: Mutafura, tarisa kuti makosha e m ane real roots mbiri anosangana muinterval ipi, uye apo anopera.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.o.a: Real numbers m dzose dzine m < 4
y-m-36-01.s.s3.r.a: Kutonga uku hakusati kwatarisa kuti equation inova nechimiro chipi pa m = 0.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.r.b: Wakasiya kukosha apo degree inochinja uye ndokushandisa inequality.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.r.c: Verenga nemaoko kana pane real roots mbiri kana m iri negative zvakare (semuenzaniso, m = −1). Pamwe wakafunga kuti m inofanira kuva positive kuti equation ive quadratic.
y-m-36-01.s.s3.r.d: Pa m = 4 roots mbiri dzinosangana, saka hadzisi real roots mbiri dzakasiyana. Hauna kusiyanisa "ine real roots" ne "dzakasiyana."
y-m-36-01.s.s3.explain: Kana m = −1, saka −x² − 4x + 1 = 0 ine real roots mbiri, uye kana m = 1, saka x² − 4x + 1 = 0 inewo real roots mbiri. m = 0 inopa linear equation (1 real root) uye m = 4 inopa double root (1 real root), saka dzinobuda murenji. Saka m < 4 ne m ≠ 0.

y-m-36-04.title: Mitsetse inopfuura papoinzi (0, 4) napoinzi (0, −4)
y-m-36-04.topic: Huwandu hwemapoinzi okusangana kweparabola nemutsetse (zvirevo zve quadratic zvakabatanidzwa)
y-m-36-04.goal: Tarisa kutonga kwekutanga, "kuchinja slope hakuchinji huwandu hwemapoinzi okusangana," nezvinopfuurwa nomutsetse, uye utsanangure kuti sei mhedzisiro inosiyana mumuumbi mumwe chete.
y-m-36-04.material: Parabola y = x² iri pacoordinate plane. Vertex yayo ndiyo origin uye inovhura kumusoro. Poinzi (0, 4) iri mukati meparabola (pamusoro pekakona), uye poinzi (0, −4) iri kunze kwayo (pasi pekakona). m inhamba chaiyo, uye hatifungi nezvemitsetse inofanana neaxis ye y. Mutsetse y = mx + 4 unopfuura papoinzi (0, 4), uye mutsetse y = mx − 4 unopfuura papoinzi (0, −4). Huwandu hwemapoinzi okusangana ihuwandu hwemhinduro chaiyo (x, y) dzezvirevo zvakabatanidzwa.
y-m-36-04.thinking.1: Kuenzanisa kuti mhedziso inochinja sei kana mamiriro (poinzi inopfuurwa) achichinja
y-m-36-04.thinking.2: Kutsanangura huwandu hwemapoinzi okusangana uchishandisa zvirevo nenzvimbo dzezvimiro
y-m-36-04.prereq.1: Kuverenga mutsetse y = mx + n semutsetse pacoordinate plane — H2 yebasa iri inongova nhanho yokuoma nokutsigira mukugoverwa kwokugadzirwa uku; haireve kuti kurikulamu inopa chidzidzo icho kugiredhi iroro. Fungidzira kuti ruzivo rwokutanga rwuri pazasi rwatodzidzwa.
y-m-36-04.s.s1.prompt: Sezvaunochinja m mumutsetse y = mx + 4 unopfuura papoinzi (0, 4), chii chinoitika kuhuwandu hwemapoinzi okusangana neparabola y = x²? Sarudza kutonga kwako kwekutanga.
y-m-36-04.s.s1.hint.0: Isa m = 0, 1, 10, −3 imwe panguva imwe, ita x² yakaenzana nechirevo chomutsetse, uye uverenge midzi chaiyo.
y-m-36-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cherechedza kuti chirevo chokupedzisira chine chimiro chipi, pasinei nokuti m ndeipi.
y-m-36-04.s.s1.o.a: Pasinei nokuti m ine kukosha kupi, kunogara kuine mapoinzi okusangana 2.
y-m-36-04.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunobatanidza nzvimbo yepoinzi nehuwandu hwemapoinzi okusangana.
y-m-36-04.s.s1.o.b: Zvichienderana nokukosha kwa m, mapoinzi okusangana 0, 1, ne 2 zvose zvinoitika.
y-m-36-04.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga uku kunofunga kuti mutsetse wakatsvedzera ungashayikwa neparabola. Isa m = 0, 1, 10 uye utsvage mapoinzi okusangana.
y-m-36-04.s.s1.o.c: Kana m = 0 pane poinzi 1 yokusangana, uye kana m ≠ 0 pane 2.
y-m-36-04.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunofunga kuti mutsetse wakarara y = 4 unosangana neparabola papoinzi imwe chete. Verenga mhinduro dza x² = 4.
y-m-36-04.s.s1.o.d: Pasinei nokuti m ine kukosha kupi, kunogara kuine poinzi 1 yokusangana.
y-m-36-04.s.s1.r.d: Unogona kunge wakavhiringidza mutsetse unobata nemutsetse unotema. Tsvaga iwe pachako mapoinzi okusangana kana m = 0.
y-m-36-04.s.s1.explain: x² = mx + 4 inova x² − mx − 4 = 0, uye kukosha kunosarudza huwandu hwemidzi ndi m² + 16, iri huru kupfuura 0 pasinei nokuti m ndeipi. Saka kunogara kuine midzi chaiyo miviri yakasiyana, ndiko kuti, mapoinzi okusangana 2. Izvi zvinoitika nokuti poinzi (0, 4) iri mukati meparabola, saka mutsetse wedivi ripi neripi unotema kakona kaviri.
y-m-36-04.s.s2.prompt: Panguva ino ndimutsetse y = mx − 4, unopfuura papoinzi (0, −4). Yedza kana kutonga kwako kwekutanga ("nguva dzose huwandu hwakafanana") kunoshandawo kumutsetse uyu. Isa nhamba dzizere 2 dzakasiyana m dzinoita kuti mutsetse uyu usasangane neparabola y = x².
y-m-36-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kana m = 0, dhirowa kana shandisa zvirevo kuti utarise kana y = −4 ne y = x² zvichisangana.
y-m-36-04.s.s2.hint.1: Uchichinja kukosha kwa m, rongedza patafura kana x² − mx + 4 = 0 ine midzi kana isina.
y-m-36-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Ndapota ita m ive nhamba yakazara.
y-m-36-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Kune m iyi, mutsetse neparabola hazvisangani.
y-m-36-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Kune m iyi, mutsetse neparabola zvinosangana. Tsvaga iwe pachako midzi chaiyo ye x² = mx − 4.
y-m-36-04.s.s2.explain: x² = mx − 4 inova x² − mx + 4 = 0, uye kukosha kunosarudza huwandu hwemidzi ndi m² − 16. Kana −4 < m < 4 iri negative, saka hazvisangani; kana m = ±4 ndi 0, saka zvinosangana papoinzi imwe (mutsetse unobata); uye kana |m| > 4 zvinosangana pamapoinzi 2. Kutonga kwekutanga kwakashanda chete kupoinzi (0, 4).
y-m-36-04.s.s3.prompt: Kana wakatanga kufunga kuti "kuchinja slope kunopa huwandu hwakafanana hwemapoinzi okusangana," unofanira kugadzirisa kutonga uku sei? Enzanisa mitsetse miviri (unopfuura papoinzi (0, 4) nounopfuura papoinzi (0, −4)) uye utsanangure, uchishandisa zvirevo kana nzvimbo dzemapoinzi, kuti sei mhedzisiro dzakasiyana.
y-m-36-04.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza imwe yenyaya mbiri uye unyore x² = mx ± 4 yakarongwazve kuti x² nezwi remutsetse ziri padivi rimwe.
y-m-36-04.s.s3.hint.1: Muzvirevo zviviri zvakarongwazve, enzanisa chikamu chisingachinji pasinei nokuti m ndeipi nechikamu chinochinja na m.
y-m-36-04.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Munyaya yokupfuura papoinzi (0, 4), ... , uye munyaya yokupfuura papoinzi (0, −4), ...
y-m-36-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mutsananguro yangu, musiyano wakajeka here wokuti y = mx + 4 inogara ichipa 2 apo y = mx − 4 inochinja na m?
y-m-36-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakatsanangura here chikonzero chomusiyano uchishandisa zvirevo (m² + 16 ne m² − 16) kana nzvimbo dzemapoinzi (mukati nokunze)?
y-m-36-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ndakanyorazve here kutonga kwekutanga, ndichiwedzera mamiriro anoti inorurama munyaya ipi?
y-m-36-04.s.s3.model.0: Poinzi (0, 4) iri mukati meparabola, saka y = mx + 4 inopa x² − mx − 4 = 0, uye sezvo m² + 16 ichigara iri pamusoro, pane mapoinzi okusangana 2 kuna m ipi neipi. Poinzi (0, −4) iri kunze, saka x² − mx + 4 = 0 inopa m² − 16, iyo inoita huwandu 0, 1, kana 2 zvichienderana na m. Saka kutonga kwekutanga kwakarurama chete kumitsetse inopfuura nepoinzi iri mukati.
y-m-36-04.s.s3.model.1: Pfungwa yokuti nguva dzose yakafanana inofanira kugadziriswa. Mutsetse y = mx − 4 hausangani neparabola kana −4 < m < 4, unosangana papoinzi imwe kana m = ±4, uye unosangana pamapoinzi maviri kune dzimwe. Zvakasiyana, mutsetse unopfuura pa (0, 4) unosangana pamapoinzi maviri kuna m ipi neipi. Zvinoenderana nokuti poinzi inopfuurwa nemutsetse iri mukati kana kunze kweparabola.
y-m-36-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Yakatsanangurwa uchishandisa nzvimbo yemapoinzi uye zvirevo zvakashandiswa chete muchikamu.

y-m-36-03.title: Kana mumwe mudzi uri 1+i, mumwe mudzi uri upi?
y-m-36-03.topic: Mamiriro umo hunhu hwemudzi we complex nokuenderana huchishanda
y-m-36-03.goal: Rongedza iwe pachako, uchitarisa kutonga kwako nguva dzose kana ruzivo rwakawedzera, kuti hunhu hwemudzi wokuenderana hunovimbiswa pasi pemamiriro api (mhando yema coefficients).
y-m-36-03.material: Mumwe mudzi wechirevo che quadratic x² + px + q = 0 unonzi ndi 1 + i. (i ndiyo imaginary unit ine i² = −1, inoverengwa: ai) Nguva dzose kana ruzivo rumwe rwakawedzerwa, tonga zvaunogona kutaura pamusoro pe "mumwe mudzi."
y-m-36-03.thinking.0: Rongedza kuti unogona kuenda kure zvakadini neruzivo rwazikanwa chete
y-m-36-03.thinking.1: Gadzirisa kutonga kwako nokuvimba kwako zvichienderana neruzivo rutsva
y-m-36-03.thinking.2: Tsvaga mamiriro umo hunhu hunoshanda, nemienzaniso inopikisa
y-m-36-03.prereq.0: Nhamba dza complex a + bi nenhamba dza complex dzokuenderana, i² = −1
y-m-36-03.prereq.1: Kutaura huwandu nechakawanikwa chemidzi miviri yechirevo che quadratic nema coefficients acho (nhanho yeyuniti yezvirevo yeGiredhi 10) — H2 yebasa iri inongova nhanho yokuoma nokutsigira mukugoverwa kwokugadzirwa uku; haireve kuti kurikulamu inopa chidzidzo icho kugiredhi iroro. Fungidzira kuti ruzivo rwokutanga rwuri pazasi rwatodzidzwa.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.prompt: Kutambira ruzivo rumwe panguva imwe, nguva dzose sarudza zvaunogona kutaura pamusoro pemumwe mudzi "kubva pazvazikanwa parizvino chete."
y-m-36-03.s.s1.hint.0: Pachikamu chega chega, nyora kana ruzivo rwakapiwa nyowani rwuri pamusoro pa p ne q kana pamusoro pemidzi.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.hint.1: Usati wasarudza mhinduro, verenga iwe pachako huwandu nechakawanikwa uye utarise kana kukosha uku kuri nhamba chaiyo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Zvinozikanwa: mumwe mudzi uri 1 + i. Hapana chinoti p ne q inhamba dzemhando ipi.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kubva pazvazikanwa parizvino chete, mumwe mudzi unogona kusarudzwa here?
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana usingazivi kuti p ne q inhamba dzemhando ipi, mumwe mudzi ungava chero. Kutonga kunovimbika pachikamu ichi ndekutaura kuti hakugoni kusarudzwa. Kana wakafungidzira usingataure kuti "p ne q inhamba chaiyo" ukapindura 1 − i, uchatarisa pachikamu chinotevera kana pfungwa iyoyo yakapiwa soruzivo chaiyo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Dambudziko haridi kuti p ne q inhamba chaiyo, asi unogona kunge wakafungidzira kudaro. Kana wakashandisa pfungwa, zvakanaka kuinyora.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Hapana ruzivo pamusoro pa p ne q, saka hakugoni kusarudzwa.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Hauna kufungidzira ruzivo rwuri husina kupiwa, uye wakamirira kutonga kwako.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Unogona kunge wakafunga mutemo wokuchinja zviratidzo zvose. Kusvikira wakaverenga huwandu nechakawanikwa iwe pachako, hapana hwaro hwawo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kutonga uku kunotora "mudzi mumwe unozikanwa" ne "midzi inoenzana" sezvakafanana.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Ruzivo rutsva: p ne q dzose inhamba chaiyo. Kana mumwe mudzi uri s + ti (s ne t inhamba chaiyo), huwandu hwemidzi miviri (1 + s) + (1 + t)i nechakawanikwa (s − t) + (s + t)i zvose zvinofanira kuva nhamba chaiyo. (Chakawanikwa ndi (1 + i)(s + ti) = s + ti + si + ti² chakaitwa chiduku.)
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Kuti huwandu hwuve chaiyo, 1 + t = 0, saka t = −1, uye kuti chakawanikwa chive chaiyo, s + t = 0, saka s = 1. Saka mumwe mudzi ndi 1 − i. Kutonga kwapfuura kwokuti hazvigoni kusarudzwa kwakanga kwakarurama nokuti ruzivo rwakanga rusina kukwana, uye ikozvino kwachinja nokuti ruzivo rwakawedzera.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakaenzanisa chikamu che imaginary chete kuti huwandu hwuve chaiyo uye hauna kutarisa chakawanikwa. Verenga kana chakawanikwa chiri chaiyo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kana midzi miviri yakafanana, huwandu 2 + 2i hausi nhamba chaiyo. Tarisa kana huwandu huri hwechaiyo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ruzivo rutsva runopa zvirevo zviviri, huwandu nechakawanikwa, asi wakaramba wakamirira kutonga kwako sezvawakaita kare.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uku kukosha kwaunowana nokutsvaga s ne t dzinoita kuti huwandu nechakawanikwa zvose zvive chaiyo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Tinochinja ruzivo rumwe. Panguva ino, tinobvisa chirevo chokuti p ne q inhamba chaiyo, uye tinoti mumwe mudzi ndi 2. Wobva wava x² + px + q = (x − (1 + i))(x − 2) = x² − (3 + i)x + (2 + 2i), saka p = −3 − i ne q = 2 + 2i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Mumuenzaniso uyu, p = −3 − i ne q = 2 + 2i hadzisi nhamba chaiyo, saka inyaya iri kunze kwepfungwa yokuti "ma coefficients ari chaiyo." Pasina pfungwa iyoyo, haugoni kuti mudzi mumwe 1 + i oga unoita kuti mumwe mudzi ive 1 − i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Pasina pfungwa yokuti p ne q inhamba chaiyo, haugoni kuti mumwe mudzi ndi 1 − i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waparadzanisa kuti hunhu hwemudzi wokuenderana hunomira papfungwa ipi.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kana mumwe mudzi uri 1 + i, mumwe mudzi unogara uri 1 − i.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Tarisazve kuti mumwe mudzi ndeupi mumuenzaniso watakagadzira.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Midzi yechirevo che quadratic inogara iri nhamba chaiyo imwe ne imaginary imwe.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Midzi miviri 1 + i ne 2 mumuenzaniso uyu inogona kuratidzika sepeya yakadaro, asi mhando yemidzi inoenderana nema coefficients. Funga nyaya apo midzi yose miviri iri chaiyo kana ma coefficients ari chaiyo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Kunyange kana p ne q ari chaiyo, mumwe mudzi ungasava 1 − i.

y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.info: Ruzivo rwokupedzisira: zvakare p ne q ichaiyo, asi panguva ino mumwe mudzi uri 1 + √2, usiri imaginary. Semuenzaniso, kana mumwe mudzi uri 3, wobva wava (x − (1 + √2))(x − 3) = x² − (4 + √2)x + 3 + 3√2, uye pano p = −4 − √2 ne q = 3 + 3√2 dzose chaiyo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.ask: Unogona kutaura kuti mumwe mudzi ndi 1 − √2 here?
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.after: Mamiriro okuti p ne q ichaiyo oga haasarudzi mumwe mudzi kuva 1 − √2. 1 − √2 inovimbiswa chete kana paine mamiriro akasimba okuti p ne q ine rational.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.o.a: Kana p ne q ichaiyo, inogara iri 1 − √2.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Tarisa kuti mumwe mudzi ndeupi mumuenzaniso watakangopa.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Inofanira kuva mudzi wakapetwa, wakafanana na 1 + √2.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Kutonga uku kunotora "mudzi mumwe unozikanwa" ne "mudzi wakapetwa" sezvakafanana.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Wakatakura mutemo wakashandiswa kumidzi ye imaginary, uchichinja chiratidzo chete. Tarisa huwandu nechakawanikwa.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.o.d: Hakugoni kusarudzwa. Kunyange kana mumwe mudzi uri 3, p ne q ichaiyo.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Wakasimbisa nomuenzaniso kuti mamiriro oga okuti ma coefficients ari chaiyo haakwani.
y-m-36-03.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga pakanga pasina ruzivo, saka "hakugoni kusarudzwa" kwaiva kutonga kwakarurama, uye kana ruzivo rwokuti "p ne q ichaiyo" rwakasvika, kutonga kwakachinja kuva 1 − i. y-m-36-05.title: Mhando ye k inoshanda kunhamba chaiyo x dzose
y-m-36-05.topic: Mamiriro okuti kusaenzana kwe quadratic kuve kwechokwadi kunhamba chaiyo dzose, nokukosha kwomuganho
y-m-36-05.goal: Paradzanisa kana mhedzisiro yokutarisa kukosha kushoma ihumbowo kana humbowo hwakakwana, uye usimbise kuti kana kukosha kwomuganho kunosanganisirwa kunochinja zvichienderana nokuti chiratidzo chokusaenzana ndi > kana ≥.
y-m-36-05.material: Sarudza nhanho nenhanho mhando ye k umo kusaenzana x² − 4x + k > 0 kuri kwechokwadi kunhamba chaiyo x dzose. (Verenga se: x sikweya bvisa 4x pamwe k yakakura kupfuura 0) Ruzivo rumwe runopiwa nguva yega yega.
y-m-36-05.thinking.0: Tonga kana mhedzisiro yokutarisa kukosha kushoma ingaparadzirwa
y-m-36-05.thinking.1: Isa iwe pachako kukosha kwomuganho kuti usarudze kana kwakasanganiswa
y-m-36-05.thinking.2: Enzanisa kuti mhedziso inochinja sei kana mamiriro achichinja
y-m-36-05.prereq.0: Kukosha kudiki nevertex yebasa re quadratic
y-m-36-05.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pokusaenzana kwe quadratic negirafu yebasa re quadratic (nhanho yeyuniti yezvirevo nokusaenzana yeGiredhi 10) — H2 yebasa iri inongova nhanho yokuoma nokutsigira mukugoverwa kwokugadzirwa uku; haireve kuti kurikulamu inopa chidzidzo icho kugiredhi iroro. Fungidzira kuti ruzivo rwokutanga rwuri pazasi rwatodzidzwa.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.prompt: Nguva dzose kana ruzivo rwapiwa, sarudza "zvaunogona kutaura kubva pazvazikanwa parizvino."
y-m-36-05.s.s1.hint.0: Isa zvakananga kukosha kwomuganho kwa k muchirevo, uchinyorazve muchimiro (x − 2)², uye utarise kukosha kwacho pa x = 2.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.hint.1: Isa kukosha kumwe chete kwa k munyaya ye > nenyaya ye ≥ uye uenzanise kana imwe neimwe inoshanda.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Na k = 5, kuisa x = −1, 0, 2, 3, 6 kwakapa kukosha kwechirevo 10, 5, 1, 2, 17 nenhevedzano, dzose dziri pamusoro.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Kukosha kutanhatu humbowo hwakanaka, asi hahusi kutarisa kunhamba chaiyo dzose. Kana uchiziva chimiro chechirevo (kukosha kudiki zvikuru kwechirevo ichi), unogona kuva nechokwadi, uye chirevo ichi chine kukosha kwacho kudiki zvikuru, 1, pa x = 2, saka k = 5 inoshanda chaizvo.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Sezvo kukosha kwose kwechishanu kuri pamusoro, tinogona kuva nechokwadi kuti kunoshanda kunhamba chaiyo x dzose.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kutonga uku hakusati kwafunga nezvegwatidzo pakati pemapoinzi 5 akatariswa nenhamba chaiyo dzose.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvinogona kuva zvechokwadi, asi mitengo mishanu oga haigone kutiita tiine chokwadi.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kutonga uku kunosiyanisa mitengo yakatarisirwa ne generalization.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Mutengo i mudiki pa x = 2, saka hazvishande.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Kutonga uku kunoti hazvishande nekuti mutengo i mudiki, kunyange mutengo 1 i positive. Chinodiwa ne inequality i kuti mutengo ive mukuru kupfuura 0.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kuisa mitengo yakawanda hakuzotiudza, saka hatigone kusarudza.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hauna kusiyanisa muganhu wekuisa mitengo yakawanda nechokwadi chekuti chimiro che expression chinokubvumira kutarisa.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Kucherechedza: kuisa x = 2 kunopa mutengo we expression 4 − 8 + k = k − 4. Uye mutengo pa x = 2 i mutengo mudiki zvikuru we expression iyi.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ipapo range ipi yaungatarisira ye k?
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Simbi yemutengo mudiki k − 4 inosarudza mamiriro. Kana k > 4, mitengo yese i positive, uye kana k < 4, inova negative pa x = 2. Pamuganhu k = 4, unofanira kuedza zvakananga kuti uzive kana ichisanganisirwa.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Iyi i fungidziro yekuti mutengo mudiki k − 4 unofanira kuva mukuru kupfuura 0.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Iyi i fungidziro yekuti mutengo mudiki k − 4 unofanira kuva 0 kana kupfuura. Usati waedza muganhu k = 4, iyi i fungidziro ine musoro.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ungangodaro wakanganisa k = 5 yakatarisirwa kare semuganhu. Isa k = 4.5.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Iyi i fungidziro yekuti expression inogara iri positive kana k i positive. Wana mutengo pa x = 2 kana k = 1.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Kuedza muganhu: kana k = 4, expression i x² − 4x + 4 = (x − 2)². Mutengo pa x = 2 i 0, uye i positive pa x dzimwe dzese.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mu inequality yekutanga x² − 4x + k > 0, k = 4 i mukati merange here?
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Mutengo pa x = 2 i 0, saka "greater than 0" haishande. Saka k = 4 yakasiyiwa uye range i k > 4. Kana wakatarisira b mudanho rakapfuura, kuedza uku kwakachinja fungidziro yako, uye kana wakatarisira a, kwakasimbisa kuti fungidziro yako yakarurama.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: I mukati. Nekuti i positive pa x dzakawanda
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakaverenga "real numbers dzese" se "real numbers dzakawanda".
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Haugone kuziva kana i mukati usingaone dambudziko.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waigona kusarudza nekuisa mutengo wemuganhu zvakananga, asi hauna kuzviita.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Haisi mukati. Mutengo i 0 pa x = 2, saka > 0 inokundikana.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakatonga kuti kana inequality ikakundikana pa poinzi imwe, haishande pa real numbers dzese.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.info: Kuchinja mamiriro: ikozvino chinja chiratidzo che inequality uye ufunge nezve k apo x² − 4x + k ≥ 0 inoshanda pa real numbers dzese x.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.ask: k = 4 i mukati merange iyi here?
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.after: (x − 2)² ≥ 0 inoshanda pa real numbers dzese x, saka k = 4 i mukati uye range i k ≥ 4. Kunyange pa expression imwechete, kuti mutengo wemuganhu unosanganisirwa kunoenderana nekuti chiratidzo i > kana ≥.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.o.a: I mukati. Kunyange mutengo pa x = 2 i 0, ≥ 0 inoshanda.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Wakatonga zvichienderana nemamiriro kana 0 yabvumirwa pamuganhu.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.o.b: Haisi mukati. Yakasiyiwa kare, saka inosiyiwa nechikonzero chimwechete.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Hauna kufunga kuti chiratidzo che inequality chakasiyana nechiratidzo che inequality yapfuura.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.o.c: Hatigone kuziva kana i mukati. Pa quadratic inequality, unofanira kugara uchigadzirisa itsva kana chiratidzo chichichinja.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Waigona kusarudza nekuisa k = 4 zvakananga, asi hauna kuzviita.
y-m-36-05.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga zvaiva zvine musoro kusava nechokwadi kubva pamitengo mishoma, ipapo kuisa mutengo wemuganhu zvakananga kwakasimbisa kana uchisanganisirwa, uye kana chiratidzo che inequality chakachinja, kutonga kwemutengo wemuganhu wakafanana kwakachinja. Taura kuti ruzivo rupi rwakachinja kutonga kwako uye rupi rwakarega kutonga kwako kuchiramba sezvakanga.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngatishandise kutonga uku kudambudziko idzva. Ndeipi yaya i range ye k apo inequality −x² + 6x + k < 0 inoshanda pa real numbers dzese x?
y-m-36-05.s.s2.hint.0: Isa x = 3 uye utaure mutengo we expression nema k. Funga kana mutengo uyu i poinzi yepamusoro pagraph.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isa k = −9 ne k = −10 zvakananga uye uenzanise kana inequality ichishanda pa x = 3.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.r.a: Mushure mekunyora zvakare expression, tarisa kana masimbi nekuverenga kwema constants zvakarurama uchishandisa mutengo mukuru we −x² + 6x.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.r.b: Wakawana mutengo mukuru we −x² + 6x + k uye wakatonga kuti unofanira kuva shoma kupfuura 0.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.r.c: Hauna kutarisa kana pamuganhu k = −9 mutengo mukuru unova 0, saka < 0 inokundikana.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.r.d: Wakaverenga nzira yechiratidzo che inequality kune imwe divi. Wana mutengo pa x = 3 kana k = 0.
y-m-36-05.s.s2.explain: −x² + 6x + k = −(x − 3)² + 9 + k, saka mutengo mukuru i 9 + k pa x = 3. Mutengo uyu unofanira kuva shoma kupfuura 0, saka k < −9, uye kana k = −9 mutengo pa x = 3 i 0, saka < 0 inokundikana.

y-m-36-06.title: Kuwana k kuti pave nemhinduro 7 dze integer
y-m-36-06.topic: Mhinduro dze absolute value inequality nehuwandu hwema integer solutions
y-m-36-06.goal: Verenga mhinduro ye absolute value inequality se interval, uwane kuti huwandu hwema integer solutions hunochinja sei neparameter, gadzira mitengo yakawanda inogutsa mamiriro, uye utsanangure range yadzo.
y-m-36-06.material: Pa positive number k, verenga ma integers x anogutsa inequality |x − 1| ≤ k. (Verenga se: absolute value ye x minus 1 i less than or equal to k) Semuenzaniso, kana k = 1.5, ma integers x i 0, 1, 2, saka i 3.
y-m-36-06.thinking.0: Wana mapoinzi apo huwandu hunochinja painochinja parameter
y-m-36-06.thinking.2: Tsanangura range nekuwana kana mutengo wemuganhu unosanganisirwa

y-m-36-06.prereq.1: Kuverenga ma integers panumber line (padanho reyuniti ye equations ne inequalities yegiredhi re10) — H2 yebasa iri i danho rekunetsa nerekutsigira chete mukugoverwa uku kwekugadzira; hazvireve kuti curriculum inopa chidzidzo icho kugiredhi iroro. Fungidzira kuti ruzivo rwunodiwa pazasi rwatodzidzwa.
y-m-36-06.s.s1.prompt: Kana ukatanga k pa 2 uye ukaiwedzera zvishoma nezvishoma, huwandu hwema integers x hunochinja rini?

y-m-36-06.s.s1.r.a: Ungangodaro wakatsamwiswa nemuenzaniso wemhinduro 3 kana k = 1.5. Nyora mhinduro dze k = 2 ne k = 2.5 se intervals, verenga ma integers, uye uenzanise.
y-m-36-06.s.s1.o.b: Unochinja nguva dzese k painova integer, uye panguva iyoyo ma integers maviri x anowedzerwa pakarepo.

y-m-36-06.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunofungidzira kuti integer imwe inowedzerwa nguva imwe neimwe kureba kwe interval 2k kuchikura ne 1. Nyora mhinduro dze k = 2 ne k = 2.5 se intervals, verenga ma integers, uye uenzanise.
y-m-36-06.s.s1.o.d: Unochinja nguva dzese k painova integer, uye nguva imwe neimwe integer imwe x inowedzerwa.

y-m-36-07.title: Range ipi ye a inopa chikamu chakafanana?
y-m-36-07.topic: Mamiriro ekuti system ye linear inequalities ive nemhinduro (mutengo wemuganhu)
y-m-36-07.goal: Kana uchisarudza mamiriro ekuti ma inequalities maviri ave nechikamu chakafanana, simbisa nekuisa zvakananga kuti mhedzisiro pamutengo wemuganhu inosiyana zvichienderana nerudzi rwechiratidzo che inequality, uye ukurudzire nzira yekuramba kutonga kwakaipa.
y-m-36-07.material: Minsu akawana range ye a apo system ye inequalities 3x − 1 > 5 , x − a ≤ 3 (x i real number, a i real constant) ine mhinduro, seizvi. y-m-36-10.topic: Kugadzira mamiriro ehurefu uchishandisa quadratic inequality
y-m-36-10.goal: Nyora mamiriro ane muganhu wekureba sequadratic inequality, wana chiyero chehurefu hunogoneka, uye utonge kuti chiyero chinochinja sei kana muganhu wawedzerwa uye mune nyaya ipi mune hurefu humwe chete hunogoneka.
y-m-36-10.material: Rwodzi rwefenzi rwe20 m chaiyo rwunoshandiswa kuvharira mativi matatu edimba rerectangle. Divi rasara rinoiswa pamadziro. Rega kureba kwedivi rakatarisana nemadziro kuve w m uye kureba kwedivi rimwe perpendicular nairo kuve x m. Ipapo rwodzi runopa w + 2x = 20. Nzvimbo i x·w ㎡, uye chinangwa idimba rine nzvimbo ye48 ㎡ kana kupfuura. Hurefu hwose hwakakura kupfuura 0, uye yuniti i m.
